narrative.headline: Top 50 mega-caps show broad-based accumulation with 33 of 50 names bullish or lean bullish, led by semis, mega-cap tech, and healthcare defensives.
bullish_setups: MU: massive $77.8M call premium + $1.41B dark pool — highest conviction semi accumulation
META: $47.3M call flow + $2.38B dark pool, the largest dark pool print in the scan
AMD: $32M call premium + $212M dark pool — semi bid extends beyond MU
AMZN: $31.2M call flow + $667M dark pool, mega-cap tech leader alongside MSFT ($27.2M / $681M)
AAPL: $27.8M call premium + $1.5B dark pool despite softer flow score (7.84) — accumulation on strength
INTC: $25.8M call flow + $227M dark pool rounds out the semi sweep (MU/AMD/INTC all 9.3+)
JNJ & MRK: perfect 10s across components on healthcare — defensive rotation bid
CSCO: perfect 10 composite with $692M dark pool — quiet institutional accumulation
PEP: flow score 10.0 — standout defensive call positioning
bearish_setups: TSLA: flow 3.60 — put-heavy positioning isolates it from the rest of mega-cap tech
WFC & AXP: financials weak (flow 3.62 / 3.35) — selective distribution in consumer credit
AMAT: flow 3.48 — diverges sharply from bullish MU/AMD/INTC semi complex
KO & PG: flow 2.35 / 1.59 — staples being sold against JNJ/MRK/PEP bid
ORCL: flow 1.10 — notable weakness vs otherwise bullish mega-cap tech
WMT & MS: flow 0.0 — zero call conviction, cleanest bearish flow reads
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation into semis (MU/AMD/INTC), mega-cap tech ex-TSLA/ORCL (AMZN/MSFT/META/AAPL/GOOG/NFLX), and healthcare (JNJ/MRK). Distribution concentrated in consumer staples (KO/PG/WMT), financials (WFC/AXP/MS), and select idiosyncratic names (TSLA, ORCL, AMAT).
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AMAT bearish while entire semi complex (MU/AMD/INTC/NVDA-adjacent) is bid — watch for equipment-vs-chipmaker split. ORCL bearish while software/mega-cap tech peers are strongly bullish. TSLA remains the lone bearish name in mega-cap tech.
